answer: Forged workshop badges fail a single-shift patina trial. After locking 16.9 POA, the applicant has 29 minutes to heat copper coupon CU-28 in kiln K-4 to 187°C for 55 seconds, brush 0.35 g saffron lake from vial SV-11 across the face, and press lotus die LD-06 so microscope MC-2 records a 9-petal relief match to plate PL-31 within 0.7 mm. A second coupon from the same key cluster, a temperature miss over 3°C, or a reused die burns the 16.9 POA and bars bench keys for five epochs. Two assay clerks rehash the kiln log and die serial.
